# Functions

Built-in functions, and how to write your own. 7 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## abs {#abs}

```carve
abs(%number%)
```

The number without its minus sign.

```carve
send "%abs(-3)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## floor / ceil / round {#floor}

```carve
floor(%number%)
ceil(%number%)
ceiling(%number%)
round(%number%)
```

Rounds down, up, or to the nearest whole number.

```carve
send "%round(2.6)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## location {#location}

```carve
location(%number%, %number%, %number%[, %world%])
```

Makes a location, optionally in a world.

```carve
teleport player to location(0, 64, 0)
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [types](../syntax/types.md)

## min / max {#min_max}

```carve
min(%number%, %number%)
max(%number%, %number%)
```

The smaller or bigger of two numbers.

```carve
send "%max(3, 7)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## mod {#mod}

```carve
mod(%number%, %number%)
```

Remainder, always 0 or more: `mod(-1, 5)` is 4.

```carve
send "%mod(7, 3)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## Script functions {#script_function}

```carve
function <name>([<param>: <type> [= <default>], ...]) [:: <type>]:
```

Defines a function callable from any script, as a value or on its own line. A script function wins over a built-in with the same name.

```carve
function coins(p: player) :: number:
    return {coins::%uuid of {_p}%} ? 0
on join:
    send "%coins(player)% coins" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions](../syntax/functions.md)

## sqrt {#sqrt}

```carve
sqrt(%number%)
```

Square root. A negative number is an error.

```carve
send "%sqrt(16)%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)
